# AI News Radar

> Real-time panoramic intelligence radar for global frontier AI breakthroughs, verified leader signals, hands-on tutorials, and vetted developer tools.

AI News Radar (https://ainewsradar.xyz) provides verified, signal-dense updates on frontier large language models, agent architectures, developer tooling, and real-world implementations. All intelligence is vetted against primary sources, benchmark results, and production code repositories.

## Core Platform Sections

- [Frontier AI News](https://ainewsradar.xyz/#news): Real-time vetted breakthroughs, model weights releases, and technical papers.
- [Applied AI Tools](https://ainewsradar.xyz/#tools): Curated developer utilities, agent runtimes, and local AI software.
- [Social Radar Signals](https://ainewsradar.xyz/#celebrity): Verified statements and technical debates from primary AI researchers and founders.

- [Daily Briefing Archive](https://ainewsradar.xyz/daily): Chronological daily digests of global AI advancements.
